words.zh: 使……加快；使……增速
words.ex_en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
words.ex_zh: 加快经济增长速度的措施

words.zh: 淹没；把…淹死
words.ex_en: Many people drowned when the boat overturned.

words.zh: 全国范围的；全国性的
words.ex_en: a nationwide search for a missing British tourist
words.ex_zh: 在全国范围内对一名失踪英国游客的搜寻

words.zh: 吐痰；吐口水；发出劈啪声
words.ex_en: Nick rolled down his window and spat.
words.ex_zh: 尼克摇下窗子，啐了口唾沫。

words.zh: 洗衣店，洗衣房；要洗的衣服；洗熨；洗好的衣服
words.ex_en: She did the laundry (= washed the clothes etc ) and hung it out to dry.
words.ex_zh: 她洗了衣服，然后挂出去晾干。

words.zh: 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物
words.ex_en: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
words.ex_zh: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

words.zh: 抽烟；冒气
words.ex_zh: 告示牌上写着“禁止吸烟”。

words.zh: 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播
words.ex_en: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
words.ex_zh: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

words.zh: 交易；便宜货；契约
words.ex_en: There are no bargains in the clothes shops at the moment.
words.ex_zh: 这阵子服装店里没有什么便宜货。

words.zh: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；不成功的
words.ex_en: When we entered the room, the teacher was yelling at some unfortunate student.
words.ex_zh: 我们进教室的时候，老师正在对着一个倒霉的学生吼叫。

words.zh: 背叛；出卖；泄露（秘密）；露出…迹象
words.ex_en: He felt that she had betrayed him.

words.zh: 挑战的；引起挑战性兴趣的
words.ex_en: Teaching young children is a challenging and rewarding job.
words.ex_zh: 幼儿教育是一项具有挑战性和有意义的工作。

words.zh: 有益的，有利的；可享利益的
words.ex_en: a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
words.ex_zh: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物

words.zh: 尴尬的；笨拙的；棘手的；不合适的
words.ex_en: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions .
words.ex_zh: 我希望他不要再问令人难堪的问题。

words.zh: 虫，蠕虫；蜗杆；螺纹；小人物
真正的，真实的；可信的
伤害；给留下伤痕
words.ex_en: His hands were badly scarred by the fire.
words.ex_zh: 他的双手被那次大火烧得疤痕累累。

words.zh: 水手，海员；乘船者
words.ex_zh: 六名英国海员溺水身亡。

words.zh: 悬浮；暂停；停职
words.ex_en: He received a six-month suspension for unprofessional behaviour.
words.ex_zh: 他因有违职业道德的行为被停职六个月。

words.zh: 补偿，赔偿；抵消
words.ex_en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
words.ex_zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。
